rationale: Because Sotomayor is the most senior justice in the majority and several in the majority want to narrow the Ninth Circuit’s “totality” language while still affirming under a Lindke-like, act-specific test, she is best positioned to assign and likely keep the opinion. A Roberts-led dissent is the modal outcome, with a meaningful chance of a Kavanaugh join/lead and possible Thomas separate writing to emphasize a stricter “under color” attribution rule.
